pages.text: ## Popular numbers we don't repeat, and why Some of the most widely quoted screen time figures don't hold up when you trace them to their source. We left them out. The best measured figure is a median of 51 pickups a day for US teens (Common Sense Media, 2023). Widely shared adult figures such as 96 or 352 checks a day come from sponsored surveys that don't explain how checks were counted. ### How much time do French people spend on screens?
